verdict.rationale: LibreChat documents a first-party User Memory feature, and it is self-hosted, so stored data lives on the user's own machine. However, the evidence is only a page title, with no detail on viewing, editing, or deleting remembered items, nor on the storage format. Missing for 10: documented inspect/edit/delete controls for memories, evidence of an open/exportable memory storage format, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a privacy-first user, I can inspect, edit, and delete what the assistant has remembered — the memory store lives on my machine in an open format

citations.quote: Docker and npm run it on your own machine on Windows, macOS, or Linux and serve it at http://localhost:3080
It is a self-hosted web app, not a desktop installer.
